# threshreg

## Overview

`threshreg` is an R package for fitting negative binomial regression models on data subject to a known lower reporting threshold. Rather than discarding censored observations or naively interpreting them, the package incorporates the information that their underlying counts fall below the threshold into the likelihood function. The package supports both tabular and network data, with the latter represented using matrices of observed counts and covariates.

## Installation

The development version of `threshreg` can be installed from GitHub:

```r
install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("aauthur/threshreg")
```

## Development Status

The goal is to complete by the 24th: argument validation, associated testing, and creation of a basic simulation to illustrate the effect of censorship on estimated coefficients. The simulation will later be converted into a test case where we will show the modified algorithm results in covariate estimates closer to the true values. 

After these preliminary steps are completed, I will implement the likelihood.R helper and censor.R functions first, then the core loop for tabular/network data in thresreg.R, ending with methods.R. network.R is for potential network helper functions, but may be discarded. Testing will be carried out in parallel with development.
